reported_precision.extraction: All 988 metric values over 247 rows equal the binary values parsed from the workbook XML; 241 rows are also in the legacy fixture and six Nd_PVK rows are additional; retain original XML number spellings without treating their extra serialization digits as report precision
reported_precision.SCAPS_continuum_error: Unknown; a new SCAPS mesh/bias run is not a prerequisite for reported-table agreement and is required only for a stronger claim through an available authorized native route

Voc_V.physical_design_reason: 2 mV is 0.2% of a fixed 1 V device scale, about 0.08 kT/q at 300 K; it is an engineering agreement allowance, not a contact or nonlinear-solver gate

Jsc_mA_cm2.physical_design_reason: 0.02 mA/cm2 is 0.2 A/m2; plus 0.2% of the reference current, avoiding division by zero and bounding charge-collection discrepancies

FF_percent.physical_design_reason: 0.20 percentage point is 0.002 as a fraction; plus 0.2% relative permits a sub-percent power-shape difference at normal FF while retaining a near-zero absolute rule

PCE_percent.physical_design_reason: 0.10 percentage point equals 1 W/m2 at 1000 W/m2 incident power; plus 0.5% relative limits useful-power error independently of compensating Voc/Jsc/FF errors

gate_evaluation.near_zero: Use A_q + u_report with no division by reference; missing/undefined FF, PCE or Voc remains null with reason
gate_evaluation.rounding_fraction: u_report <= one third of the full comparison allowance; otherwise the reported value is too coarse for this gate and remains unresolved
gate_evaluation.SolarLab_precision: Sum independently bounded spatial, bias/time, nonlinear/current-extraction errors conservatively; require total <= min(the separately declared internal numerical target, (A_q+R_q*abs(reference))/3) before agreement is eligible
gate_evaluation.not_a_derived_fact: A_q and R_q are explicit engineering proposals, motivated by dimensional power/collection effects; they are not mathematically implied by reported digits or chosen from a new candidate error
gate_evaluation.freeze_rule: Root independently approves exact scope and numeric limits, records full source/gate/environment/input hashes and frozen_at < run_started_at before the first candidate run
gate_evaluation.failure_policy: Keep failures, investigate cause, refine within a new explicitly approved attempt; never adjust these limits to fit results

SolarLab_numerical_prerequisite.meaning: Retain section 14 internal Voc/relative targets; proposed small dimensional floors handle zero signals. These internal targets do not define the external reported-table limits.
SolarLab_numerical_prerequisite.floor_dimensions: J floor=0.001 A/m2; FF floor=1e-5 fraction; PCE floor=0.001 W/m2 at the declared 1000 W/m2 illumination hypothesis
SolarLab_numerical_prerequisite.total_error_rule: For each metric, sum independent spatial, bias/time, nonlinear and observable-extraction bounds; no cancellation or reference-table rounding substituted for a SolarLab error estimate
SolarLab_numerical_prerequisite.required_evidence: Freeze the actual driver and supported controls; resolve thin transport layers/interfaces on the actual mesh and use at least three levels on sentinel regimes then an adjacent verification on every other required coordinate; brackets, slopes, MPP search and fallback status must be recorded
SolarLab_numerical_prerequisite.old_registry_limit: The existing 30/60/90 frozen-ion scaps_mirror registry lane has a different configuration and cannot certify mirror_v2 or the reconstructed 13-group sweep

shape_gates.axes: Use log10 of donor/Nt for logarithmic axes and the reported eV coordinate for Et/CBO; keep CB and VB defects separate
shape_gates.difference: For each pair of adjacent indices on the full frozen axis with both endpoints observed, compare delta_q=q_next-q_prev with allowance L_next+L_prev; slope allowance divides by that fixed coordinate spacing. Never bridge a missing index to the next available point. L_i includes its fixed engineering limit and source rounding.
shape_gates.resolved_sign: Require matching sign when abs(delta_ref)>L_next+L_prev; smaller variations are explicitly unresolved at this agreement budget, not asserted flat or monotonic
shape_gates.turning_points: A resolvable turning point has adjacent differences of opposite resolved sign; candidate must retain the sign reversal within the same bracket or one immediate source interval, never across a missing point
shape_gates.optimum_set: For source q_i with L_i, admissible indices satisfy q_i+L_i >= max_j(q_j-L_j); candidate maximum must lie in this set and source regret at that coordinate <= L_i+L_at_source_max
shape_gates.flat_or_tied: No unique optimum/turning coordinate is required where uncertainty intervals overlap; report the admissible sampled set
shape_gates.coupling: For every fully observed adjacent 2x2 rectangle, C=q11-q10-q01+q00; require abs(C_new-C_ref)<=sum_four_corner_L and matching sign when abs(C_ref)>sum_four_corner_L
shape_gates.coupling_units: Report C in original metric units and C/(delta_logNt*delta_E) in metric per decade-eV; no position-based reshape
shape_gates.missing_rectangle: Any missing corner is reference_missing; report counts and do not include it in a passed numeric denominator
shape_gates.aggregates: All pointwise gates plus resolved shape/coupling checks must pass; Pearson/rank correlation and average error alone cannot accept
shape_gates.global_optimum_scope: Optimum claims only over observed points; the 14 missing coordinates preclude an unqualified full-grid global optimum

power_consistency.Pin_policy: 100 mW/cm2 is an explicit reconstruction assumption until native illumination evidence is supplied; compare its consistency with source tuples but do not fit Pin per point
power_consistency.required_check: Report Pmax=Pin*PCE/100 and propagated Voc/Jsc/FF error; require the direct PCE gate as well, so compensating metric errors do not hide loss
